Runs counts the runs per setting on the TPU. Experiment 0 is the stand-alone baseline run of each session in Table~\ref{tab:platforms}, which also gives its script. In September, each session also ran the baseline configuration once with the profiler. On the TPU, the baseline configuration is also one setting of experiments 2, 4, and 7, both settings of experiments 3 and 6, and all three runs of experiment 8. With experiment 0, these are the 11 runs of Section~\ref{sec:experiments}. Each script name maps to a file \texttt{src/spike\_X\_forward\_pass.py}. X is \texttt{tpu} for single, \texttt{batch} for vmap, \texttt{pmap} for pmap, \texttt{meshshard} for partitioning, and \texttt{ensemble\_shard} for ensemble. Alphabet and fixed are the repeated-alphabet and fixed sequences, followed by the length in residues when the experiment does not vary it. File gives the start of the file name. Files are in \texttt{results/sweep/}. The files of experiment 0 are in \texttt{results/}. Unless an experiment varies one of these settings, all runs use \texttt{model\_3}, no recycling, and float32 parameters.
